lines.text: Add up the tips of this star, without measuring a single angle!
lines.caption: Add up the tips of this star, without measuring a single angle!

lines.text: All you need is a pencil.
lines.caption: All you need is a pencil.

lines.text: Seven evenly spaced points, each joined to the second point after it.
lines.caption: Seven evenly spaced points, each joined to the second point after it.

lines.text: What do the seven tip angles add up to?
lines.caption: What do the seven tip angles add up to?

lines.text: Walk a pencil around the star. At every tip, the tip and the turn make one hundred eighty.
lines.caption: Walk a pencil around the star. At every tip, the tip and the turn make one hundred eighty.

lines.text: Watch it go all the way around. The pencil circles the center twice!
lines.caption: Watch it go all the way around. The pencil circles the center twice!

lines.text: Two circles is seven hundred twenty degrees of turning.
lines.caption: Two circles is seven hundred twenty degrees of turning.

lines.text: Seven times one hundred eighty is one thousand two hundred sixty.
lines.caption: Seven times one hundred eighty is one thousand two hundred sixty.

lines.text: So the tips get the rest: five hundred forty degrees!
lines.caption: So the tips get the rest: five hundred forty degrees!

lines.text: Not one hundred eighty. That's the five-point star.
lines.caption: Not one hundred eighty. That's the five-point star.

lines.text: Want to see why? The full lesson has two neat ways and every trap.
lines.caption: Want to see why? The full lesson has two neat ways and every trap.
